title: Let customers cancel a paid order

title.say: This change lets customers cancel an order they have paid for. Here is what it does to the system.

statesBefore.caption: Before: once an order was paid, it could only move on to shipping.
statesBefore.say: Before, a paid order had one way forward: it shipped, and then it was delivered.

statesAfter.caption: After: a paid order can be cancelled, and a cancelled order is refunded.
statesAfter.say: After, the customer can cancel a paid order until it ships. A cancelled order is then refunded.

failure.caption: New failure mode: if the refund fails, the order stays cancelled and unpaid back.
failure.say: There is one new way to fail. If the refund fails, nothing tries it again, and the order stays cancelled without the money going back.

close.caption: An order can now end in two ways: delivered or refunded.
close.say: The short version: an order can now end in two ways, delivered or refunded.
